verdict: All 15 acceptance criteria pass, and they pass under execution rather than by reading. node --check is clean; the export list is exactly the pinned contract plus the optional medianTariff; MERIDIAN_TARIFF_MULT/TIME_MULT are 2.5/1.6 as named constants with a ratification comment; a grep for await/async/fetch/Math.random/Date.now/.from(/.rpc(/window/document/Profile/Corp/Forge/throw/discord/webhook/upload returns nothing but comment prose. I drove the module from node: meridianQuote(null), meridianQuote(undefined), 0, '', NaN, [], {}, a negative median, a NaN median and an empty carrier list all return a fully shaped ok quote and never null/undefined/throw; median 41 x 100 units x 5 hops prices at 51250, byte-identical to sql/038's ceil(coalesce(median,40)*2.5*units*hops), and the ETA at 200 matches ceil(hops*25*1.6); an escorted at-ceiling player quote clamps to 51250 with capped:true, which is the PRICE clamp the server does at sql/038:824-828 rather than the tariff clamp an earlier round shipped; a tampered sheet with meridianTariffMult 0.5 and minutesPerHop 0 is refused back to 2.5 and the ETA is ratcheted to refMinutes+1 with guarded:true. hops() returns -1 for an unknown id and for a null node list; inReach(null,...) is false; inReach({nodeId,radius}) is true, so the reach resolver is idempotent and the r2 out-of-reach regression is genuinely fixed. Every sql/038 line citation I checked (429-430, 434-437, 444, 448-451, 733-746, 754-762, 767, 795, 804-817, 824-834) is exact, the FR_CONVOY_RISK 30 / ESC_CUT 22 / RISK_MIN 4 provenance at index.html:61128 is real, the rigs.data.js risk-in-negative-points trap and auditRigs' risk<=0 assertion are real, and the drift ledger's F1-F5 entries correspond to defects earlier critics actually found. This is well past tiers.js on every rubric dimension. What it fails is the rubric's own 'dates its own claims' line: the citations into its sibling JS files are largely wrong, and one of them asserts a live behaviour that is false.
